title: Module-linear ordinary counit square before forgetting coefficients
statement: Let R, A, B, Bp, D be commutative rings with R-algebras A, B, Bp, a compatible B-algebra structure on Bp, IsScalarTower R B Bp, and algebra structures of A tensor_R B and A tensor_R Bp on D. Assume derived categories for R, B, Bp and flatness of B to Bp. Let Q be a cochain complex of A-modules, i an integer, and L, K be the models of [def-pc-base-derived-tensor-cohomology-model] for B and Bp. Write X=(A tensor_R B) tensor_A Q, Y=(A tensor_R Bp) tensor_A Q, f:B to A tensor_R B and g:Bp to A tensor_R Bp for includeRight, and r for restriction Bp to B. Given a B-linear chain map phiB:Res_f X to r(Res_g Y) sending L.ordinaryIso(b tensor x) to K.ordinaryIso(image(b) tensor x), the B-linear identity is Res_f(L.comparison i);s_f inverse;H^i(phiB) = secondLocalizationCohomologyMap;r(Res_g(K.comparison i);s_g inverse);s_r inverse, where each s is the exact restriction-of-scalars homology isomorphism H^i(Res Z) to Res(H^i Z). Unlike the parent additive square, this statement assumes module linearity and neither constructs the B-linear lift of an additive map nor transports homology through forgetting scalar actions.

proof.text: Conjugate phiB by L.ordinaryIso.hom and the restriction of K.ordinaryIso.inv to obtain chi on the raw B and Bp tensor complexes. The generator hypothesis and inverse-isomorphism identity give the generator formula for chi. Apply the raw counit square. Naturality of the module extension/restriction adjunction cancels K.cohomologyIso.inv against K.cohomologyIso.hom and moves L.cohomologyIso.hom outside the transpose. Substitute both comparison_eq identities. Use exact restriction mapHomologyIso_inv_naturality for K.ordinaryIso, the chain identity chi;Res(K.ordinaryIso.hom)=L.ordinaryIso.hom;phiB, and functoriality of homology to finish.

proof_origin.place: Tag 06Y6; raw counit square transported through the recorded model isomorphisms

theorem secondLocalization_ordinary_B_square (hflat : (algebraMap B Bp).Flat) (i : ℤ)
    (Q : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{u} A) ℤ)
    (L : ModuleCat.BaseDerivedTensorCohomologyModel R A B Q D)
    (K : ModuleCat.BaseDerivedTensorCohomologyModel R A Bp Q D)
    (φB : ((ModuleCat.restrictScalars
        (Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight :
          B →ₐ[R] A ⊗[R] B).toRingHom).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj
        (((ModuleCat.extendScalars (algebraMap A (A ⊗[R] B))).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj
          Q) ⟶
      ((ModuleCat.restrictScalars (algebraMap B Bp)).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj
        (((ModuleCat.restrictScalars
          (Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight :
          Bp →ₐ[R] A ⊗[R] Bp).toRingHom).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj
          (((ModuleCat.extendScalars (algebraMap A (A ⊗[R] Bp))).mapHomologicalComplex (.up
            ℤ)).obj Q)))
    (hφ : ∀ (j : ℤ) (b : B) (x : Q.X j),
      φB.f j (L.ordinaryIso.hom.f j (b ⊗ₜ[R,algebraMap R B] x)) =
        K.ordinaryIso.hom.f j (algebraMap B Bp b ⊗ₜ[R,algebraMap R Bp] x)) :
    (ModuleCat.restrictScalars
      (Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight : B →ₐ[R] A ⊗[R] B).toRingHom).map
        (L.comparison i) ≫
      (((((ModuleCat.extendScalars (algebraMap A (A ⊗[R] B))).mapHomologicalComplex
        (.up ℤ)).obj Q).sc i).mapHomologyIso
          (ModuleCat.restrictScalars
            (Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight : B →ₐ[R] A ⊗[R] B).toRingHom)).inv ≫
      HomologicalComplex.homologyMap φB i =
    secondLocalizationCohomologyMap R A B Bp D hflat Q L K i ≫
      (ModuleCat.restrictScalars (algebraMap B Bp)).map
        ((ModuleCat.restrictScalars
          (Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight : Bp →ₐ[R] A ⊗[R] Bp).toRingHom).map
            (K.comparison i) ≫
          (((((ModuleCat.extendScalars (algebraMap A (A ⊗[R] Bp))).mapHomologicalComplex
            (.up ℤ)).obj Q).sc i).mapHomologyIso
              (ModuleCat.restrictScalars
                (Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight : Bp →ₐ[R] A ⊗[R] Bp).toRingHom)).inv) ≫
      (((((ModuleCat.restrictScalars
        (Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight :
          Bp →ₐ[R] A ⊗[R] Bp).toRingHom).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj
            (((ModuleCat.extendScalars (algebraMap A (A ⊗[R] Bp))).mapHomologicalComplex (.up
              ℤ)).obj Q)).sc i).mapHomologyIso (ModuleCat.restrictScalars (algebraMap B Bp))).inv
